_about: Held-out v3 (2026-09-30). Written before any model was run on it, and frozen: no rule, prompt or threshold may be chosen by looking at its failures. Larger than the v1/v2 held-out sets and the dev set, with two additions: `large_history` (six to nine past meetings, so a shortlist of candidates is actually a restriction) and colloquial variety. Categories as in dataset.py, plus large_history.
